symbols.name: ResultTaskExtensions
symbols.summary: Provides mapping operations for values produced by asynchronous result pipelines.

symbols.name: MapResult(Task>, IMapper)
symbols.summary: Awaits a result and maps its successful value while preserving result semantics.

syntax.content: public static Task> MapResult(this Task> resultTask, IMapper mapper) where TNew : class

parameters.description: The task containing the value to map.
The mapper used to transform the successful value.

returns.description: A task containing the mapped result; missing mappers, cancellation, and exceptions are represented as result errors.

symbols.name: MapResultAsync(Task>, IMapper)
symbols.summary: Asynchronously transforms the value of the specified BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.Result%601 object to a new result with the specified result type.

syntax.content: public static Task> MapResultAsync(this Task> resultTask, IMapper mapper) where TNew : class

parameters.description: A task that represents the asynchronous operation, containing the source result.
The mapper instance used to convert the value from T to TNew.

returns.description: A task that represents the asynchronous operation, containing a new BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.Result%601 instance with the transformed value, original messages, and errors.
